interventions.limitations: Transplant failures can reflect co-adapted representations, not faulty blocks. Fixed-direction local sensitivity is not a worst-case bound or proof of the original crash trigger.
interventions.scope: inference only, no learning or file mutation; copies are discarded

protocol.format: little-endian f32 arrays: expanded parameters, first moment, second moment
protocol.purpose: Raw binary weight and moment diagnosis; no training or benchmark selection
protocol.reference_limitation: Success endpoints have different training ages and independent coordinate systems

probe.gradient_scope: full-split cross entropy; contracted to independent complex coordinates before norms/cosines
